name: technical-team
description: A stack-agnostic engineering team of 14 Claude Code agents (team-lead, team-ba, team-designer, team-developer, team-qa, …) organised in squads, each owning one area of the project: tiered pipelines, quality gates G1–G4, a run kit of operating skills, a live-preview skill that tests the running product, workflow commands, per-agent skill injection from the project's technical-team.json, and an HR process for hiring domain specialists. No hooks.
